name: Worse Than We Could Imagine
source:
A visual novel about a weird school trip that goes completely wrong. Uncover forest mysteries along with teen protagonists who don't even get along that well.

[From [url=https://katketamine.itch.io/worse-than-we-could-imagine]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一場古怪的學校旅行徹底出了岔子。在這部視覺小說中，你將和幾位彼此都不怎麼合得來的少年主角一起，揭開森林裡的謎團。

［摘自[url=https://katketamine.itch.io/worse-than-we-could-imagine]itch.io[/url]］
